student_messages: Research whether tutoring centers spend time on manual scheduling before we draft the Lean Canvas.
Using the research we just reviewed, draft the Lean Canvas.

research_evidence.title: Tutoring Operations Study
research_evidence.excerpt: Tutoring centers report substantial administrative work for scheduling and reminders.

arguments.query: tutoring centers manual scheduling administrative workload

llm_responses.content: The evidence shows scheduling administration is a real operational burden. [source-tutoring-market]

arguments.problem: Tutoring centers lose time coordinating schedules, reminders, and lesson follow-ups.
arguments.solution: Automated scheduling, reminder, and follow-up workflows for tutoring teams.
arguments.unique_value_proposition: Less administrative work for tutoring centers without changing how tutors teach.
arguments.customer_segments: Independent tutoring centers and small after-school programs.
arguments.channels: Tutor owner communities and education operations newsletters.

llm_responses.content: I drafted the Lean Canvas using the scheduling-workload evidence. [source-tutoring-market]
